description: Claude Code's first-run trust dialog at 212 columns: a ─── rule, an "Accessing workspace:" heading, then a paragraph whose first sentence is the question, with digitless No/Yes rows and the highlight on "No, exit". The model reads the highlight as "Yes" here (selected 1) and quotes only the question sentence, the start of a longer row, so classify() must accept a whole sentence that runs on into its paragraph to find the prompt row and ground `selected` (0) off the ❯ row. Before it did, no prompt row matched: the misread anchor stood and no picker digest was published, so the phone refused the tap. The wrapped layout is in tests/test_cursor_select.py. Fictional screen (tmux-rc, 2026-10-12).
